Absorb Elements.name: Absorb Elements
Absorb Elements.concise_description: Resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn; the first melee hit you land before then deals an extra 1d6 damage of that type (+1d6 per slot above 1st).

Acid Splash.name: Acid Splash
Acid Splash.concise_description: One target (or two targets within 5 feet of each other) makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 acid damage (+1d6 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Alarm.name: Alarm
Alarm.concise_description: Wards a door, window, or up to a 20-foot cube; alerts you when a Tiny or larger creature (other than ones you designate) touches or enters the area, either mentally within 1 mile (waking you if asleep) or audibly as a bell for 10 seconds within 60 feet.

Animal Friendship.name: Animal Friendship
Animal Friendship.concise_description: Target beast (Intelligence 3 or lower) makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for the duration; ends early if you or a companion harms it (+1 target per slot above 1st).

Armor of Agathys.name: Armor of Agathys
Armor of Agathys.concise_description: Gain 5 temporary hit points; while any remain, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage (+5 temp HP and +5 cold damage per slot above 1st).

Arms of Hadar.name: Arms of Hadar
Arms of Hadar.concise_description: Each creature within 10 feet makes a Strength save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage and losing reactions until its next turn on a fail, or half damage with no other effect on a success (+1d6 per slot above 1st).

Bane.name: Bane
Bane.concise_description: Up to three creatures make Charisma saves; each that fails must subtract a rolled d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws until the spell ends (+1 target per slot above 1st).

Beast Bond.name: Beast Bond
Beast Bond.concise_description: Telepathic link with a touched friendly/charmed beast (fails if its Int is 4+) while in line of sight; it can share simple emotions/concepts and gains advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 feet of you that it can see.

Blade Ward.name: Blade Ward
Blade Ward.concise_description: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapon attacks until the end of your next turn.

Bless.name: Bless
Bless.concise_description: Up to three creatures add a rolled d4 to attack rolls and saving throws made before the spell ends (+1 target per slot above 1st).

Booming Blade.name: Booming Blade
Booming Blade.concise_description: Melee weapon attack against a creature within 5 feet; on hit, normal weapon damage, and the target takes 1d8 thunder damage if it willingly moves 5+ feet before the start of your next turn (both the extra melee damage and the movement damage scale up at 5th/11th/17th level).

Burning Hands.name: Burning Hands
Burning Hands.concise_description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a fail or half on a success; ignites unattended flammable objects in the area (+1d6 per slot above 1st).

Catapult.name: Catapult
Catapult.concise_description: Hurls an unattended object (1-5 lb) up to 90 feet in a line; if it would strike a creature, that creature makes a Dexterity save or is struck, and both object and target take 3d8 bludgeoning damage (max object weight +5 lb, damage +1d8 per slot above 1st).

Cause Fear.name: Cause Fear
Cause Fear.concise_description: Target (not a construct or undead) makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened of you until the spell ends, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns (+1 target within 30 feet of each other per slot above 1st).

Ceremony.name: Ceremony
Ceremony.concise_description: Choose one rite on a target within 10 feet: Atonement (DC 20 Wisdom (Insight) check restores a willing creature's original alignment); Bless Water (creates one vial of holy water); Coming of Age or Dedication (target adds a d4 to ability checks or saving throws respectively for 24 hours, once per creature); Funeral Rite (corpse can't become undead for 7 days except by Wish); Wedding (bonded humanoids gain +2 AC while within 30 feet of each other for 7 days, once per creature unless widowed).

Chaos Bolt.name: Chaos Bolt
Chaos Bolt.concise_description: Ranged spell attack dealing 2d8+1d6 damage of a type set by one of the d8s; if both d8s match, the energy leaps to a new target within 30 feet with a fresh attack and damage roll and can chain further (each target only once per casting) (+1d6 extra damage per slot above 1st).

Charm Person.name: Charm Person
Charm Person.concise_description: Target humanoid makes a Wisdom save (advantage if you or allies are fighting it) or is charmed until the spell ends or you/allies harm it; the target realizes it was charmed once the spell ends (+1 target, within 30 feet of each other, per slot above 1st).

Chill Touch.name: Chill Touch
Chill Touch.concise_description: Ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 necrotic damage; target can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn, and if undead, has disadvantage on attacks against you until the end of your next turn (+1d8 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Chromatic Orb.name: Chromatic Orb
Chromatic Orb.concise_description: Ranged spell attack (choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder) dealing 3d8 damage of the chosen type on a hit (+1d8 per slot above 1st).

Color Spray.name: Color Spray
Color Spray.concise_description: Roll 6d10 as a pool of hit points; creatures in a 15-foot cone (lowest current HP first, ignoring unconscious creatures or ones that can't see) are blinded until the end of your next turn as their HP is subtracted from the pool, until it runs out (+2d10 per slot above 1st).

Command.name: Command
Command.concise_description: Target makes a Wisdom save (no effect on undead, non-language-speakers, or harmful commands) or obeys a one-word command on its next turn - e.g. Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, or Halt, each with a defined effect; ends if the target can't comply (+1 target, within 30 feet of each other, per slot above 1st).

Compelled Duel.name: Compelled Duel
Compelled Duel.concise_description: Target makes a Wisdom save or is compelled toward you: disadvantage on attacks against others, and must succeed a Wisdom save to move more than 30 feet from you; ends if you attack another creature, target a different hostile with a spell, an ally harms/damages the target, or you end your turn 30+ feet away.

Comprehend Languages.name: Comprehend Languages
Comprehend Languages.concise_description: Understand any spoken language you hear and any written language you touch (about 1 minute per page); doesn't decode non-linguistic secret messages or glyphs.

Control Flames.name: Control Flames
Control Flames.concise_description: Choose a nonmagical flame in a 5-foot cube and: expand it 5 feet (if fuel is present), extinguish it, double/halve its light radius or change its color (1 hour), or shape it into simple animated forms (1 hour); up to three non-instantaneous effects can be active at once, each dismissible as an action.

Create Bonfire.name: Create Bonfire
Create Bonfire.concise_description: Creates a 5-foot-cube bonfire; creatures in its space when cast, or that enter or end a turn there, make a Dexterity save or take 1d8 fire damage (+1d8 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Create or Destroy Water.name: Create or Destroy Water
Create or Destroy Water.concise_description: Create up to 10 gallons of water (or rain in a 30-foot cube, extinguishing exposed flames) or destroy up to 10 gallons of water (or fog in a 30-foot cube) (+10 gallons or +5-foot cube per slot above 1st).

Cure Wounds.name: Cure Wounds
Cure Wounds.concise_description: Touched creature regains 1d8 + spellcasting modifier hit points; no effect on undead/constructs (+1d8 per slot above 1st).

Dancing Lights.name: Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.concise_description: Create up to four torch-sized lights (or combine into one Medium humanoid glow) shedding dim light in a 10-foot radius; move them up to 60 feet as a bonus action, each staying within 20 feet of another or winking out.

Detect Evil and Good.name: Detect Evil and Good
Detect Evil and Good.concise_description: Sense the presence and location of aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead, and of consecrated/desecrated places or objects, within 30 feet (blocked by 1 ft stone, 1 in metal, thin lead, or 3 ft wood/dirt).

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.concise_description: Sense magic within 30 feet; as an action, see a faint aura and learn the school of magic of any magical creature/object in range (blocked by 1 ft stone, 1 in metal, thin lead, or 3 ft wood/dirt).

Detect Poison and Disease.name: Detect Poison and Disease
Detect Poison and Disease.concise_description: Sense the presence, location, and identity of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet (blocked by 1 ft stone, 1 in metal, thin lead, or 3 ft wood/dirt).

Disguise Self.name: Disguise Self
Disguise Self.concise_description: Alter your appearance (height +-1 ft, build, features) including gear; the illusion doesn't survive physical inspection, and a creature can use an action to see through it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check vs your spell save DC.

Dissonant Whispers.name: Dissonant Whispers
Dissonant Whispers.concise_description: Target makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d6 psychic damage and being forced to use its reaction to flee from you (avoiding obvious hazards) on a fail, or half damage with no forced movement on a success; a deafened creature auto-succeeds (+1d6 per slot above 1st).

Distort Value.name: Distort Value
Distort Value.concise_description: An object up to 1 foot on a side has its perceived value doubled or halved by illusion; anyone examining it makes an Investigation check vs your spell DC (affected size +1 foot per slot above 1st).

Divine Favor.name: Divine Favor
Divine Favor.concise_description: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit for the duration.

Druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
Druidcraft.concise_description: Choose one: predict local weather 24 hours out (harmless sensory effect, 1 round); instantly bloom a flower/seed pod/leaf bud; create a harmless instantaneous sensory effect in a 5-foot cube; or light/snuff a small flame.

Earth Tremor.name: Earth Tremor
Earth Tremor.concise_description: Each creature other than you within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a fail; loose ground in the area becomes difficult terrain (+1d6 per slot above 1st).

Eldritch Blast.name: Eldritch Blast
Eldritch Blast.concise_description: Ranged spell attack dealing 1d10 force damage (an additional beam at 5th/11th/17th level, up to 4 total, each requiring its own attack roll and targetable independently).

Encode Thoughts.name: Encode Thoughts
Encode Thoughts.concise_description: Create a tangible 'thought strand' holding a memory, idea, or message from your mind (or thoughts you're reading via another effect); casting this spell again while holding a strand instantly conveys its contents to you.

Ensnaring Strike.name: Ensnaring Strike
Ensnaring Strike.concise_description: Next weapon hit before the spell ends forces a Strength save (advantage if Large or larger) or the target is restrained by vines until it or another creature succeeds a Strength check vs your spell save DC; while restrained, it takes 1d6 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns (+1d6 per slot above 1st).

Entangle.name: Entangle
Entangle.concise_description: Creates difficult terrain in a 20-foot square; creatures present when cast make a Strength save or are restrained until they succeed a Strength check vs your spell save DC.

Expeditious Retreat.name: Expeditious Retreat
Expeditious Retreat.concise_description: Take the Dash action as a bonus action on the turn you cast this and on each subsequent turn until it ends.

Faerie Fire.name: Faerie Fire
Faerie Fire.concise_description: Objects in a 20-foot cube are outlined in light of your chosen color; creatures present make a Dexterity save or are also outlined; outlined creatures/objects shed dim light 10 feet, can't benefit from invisibility, and attacks against them have advantage if the attacker can see them.

False Life.name: False Life
False Life.concise_description: Gain 1d4+4 temporary hit points for the duration (+5 temp HP per slot above 1st).

Feather Fall.name: Feather Fall
Feather Fall.concise_description: Up to five falling creatures within range descend at 60 feet/round instead; a creature that lands before the spell ends takes no falling damage and lands on its feet.

Find Familiar.name: Find Familiar
Find Familiar.concise_description: Summon a familiar spirit (celestial, fey, or fiend, your choice) with the statistics of a chosen small animal form; it acts on its own initiative, can't attack, and disappears at 0 HP (returning when recast). You can communicate with it telepathically within 100 feet, and as an action see/hear through it (blinding/deafening yourself) until the start of your next turn. A touch-range spell you cast can be delivered through it as its reaction if within 100 feet. Only one familiar at a time; recasting lets it change form instead of summoning anew.

Fire Bolt.name: Fire Bolt
Fire Bolt.concise_description: Ranged spell attack dealing 1d10 fire damage; ignites unattended flammable objects (+1d10 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Fog Cloud.name: Fog Cloud
Fog Cloud.concise_description: Creates a 20-foot-radius heavily obscuring fog sphere until dispersed by a moderate wind (10+ mph) or the duration ends (+20-foot radius per slot above 1st).

Friends.name: Friends
Friends.concise_description: Advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature for the duration; when the spell ends, the target realizes it was magically influenced and becomes hostile toward you.

Frost Fingers.name: Frost Fingers
Frost Fingers.concise_description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 cold damage on a fail or half on a success; freezes unattended nonmagical liquids in the area (+1d8 per slot above 1st).

Frostbite.name: Frostbite
Frostbite.concise_description: Target makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 cold damage and has disadvantage on its next weapon attack roll before the end of its next turn (+1d6 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Gift of Alacrity.name: Gift of Alacrity
Gift of Alacrity.concise_description: Touched willing creature adds 1d8 to its initiative rolls for the duration.

Goodberry.name: Goodberry
Goodberry.concise_description: Creates up to ten magic berries; eating one (action) restores 1 hit point and provides a day's nourishment. Unused berries lose potency after 24 hours.

Grease.name: Grease
Grease.concise_description: Turns a 10-foot square into difficult terrain; creatures standing there when cast, entering, or ending their turn there make a Dexterity save or fall prone.

Green-Flame Blade.name: Green-Flame Blade
Green-Flame Blade.concise_description: Melee weapon attack against a creature within 5 feet; on hit, normal weapon damage, and fire damage equal to your spellcasting modifier leaps to a second creature within 5 feet of the target (melee extra damage and second-target damage both scale up at 5th/11th/17th level).

Guidance.name: Guidance
Guidance.concise_description: Touched willing creature can add a rolled d4 to one ability check of its choice before the spell ends (once).

Guiding Bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
Guiding Bolt.concise_description: Ranged spell attack dealing 4d6 radiant damage; the next attack against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage (+1d6 per slot above 1st).

Gust.name: Gust
Gust.concise_description: Choose one: a Medium or smaller creature makes a Strength save or is pushed 5 feet away from you; push an unattended object (up to 5 lb) 10 feet without dealing damage; or create a harmless sensory effect using air.

Hail of Thorns.name: Hail of Thorns
Hail of Thorns.concise_description: Next ranged weapon hit before the spell ends also forces the target and each creature within 5 feet of it to make a Dexterity save, taking 1d10 piercing damage on a fail or half on a success (+1d10 per slot above 1st, max 6d10).

Healing Word.name: Healing Word
Healing Word.concise_description: Target regains 1d4 + spellcasting modifier hit points; no effect on undead/constructs (+1d4 per slot above 1st).

Hellish Rebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke
Hellish Rebuke.concise_description: The creature that damaged you makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 fire damage on a fail or half on a success (+1d10 per slot above 1st).

Heroism.name: Heroism
Heroism.concise_description: Touched willing creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, losing any remainder when it ends (+1 target per slot above 1st).

Hex.name: Hex
Hex.concise_description: Target takes an extra 1d6 necrotic damage whenever you hit it, and has disadvantage on ability checks with one chosen ability, until the spell ends; if it drops to 0 HP you can retarget with a bonus action on a later turn; Remove Curse ends it early (concentration can extend to 8 hours with a 3rd/4th-level slot, 24 hours with a 5th+-level slot).

Hunter's Mark.name: Hunter's Mark
Hunter's Mark.concise_description: Target takes an extra 1d6 damage whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception)/(Survival) checks to find it, until the spell ends; if it drops to 0 HP you can retarget with a bonus action on a later turn (concentration can extend to 8 hours with a 3rd/4th-level slot, 24 hours with a 5th+-level slot).

Ice Knife.name: Ice Knife
Ice Knife.concise_description: Ranged spell attack dealing 1d10 piercing damage; hit or miss, the shard then explodes and the target plus each creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 cold damage (+1d6 cold damage per slot above 1st).

Identify.name: Identify
Identify.concise_description: Touch an object throughout casting to learn its magical properties, attunement requirement, charges, and active spells (or the spell that created it); touching a creature instead reveals what spells currently affect it.

Illusory Script.name: Illusory Script
Illusory Script.concise_description: Written text appears normal to you and creatures you designate, or as an entirely different message you choose (in a language you know) to everyone else, and is otherwise unintelligible. Dispelling destroys both the real script and the illusion; truesight reads the hidden message.

Infestation.name: Infestation
Infestation.concise_description: Target makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 poison damage and is forced 5 feet in a random direction (no opportunity attacks provoked; blocked movement is negated) (+1d6 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Inflict Wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
Inflict Wounds.concise_description: Melee spell attack dealing 3d10 necrotic damage on a hit (+1d10 per slot above 1st).

Jim's Magic Missile.name: Jim's Magic Missile
Jim's Magic Missile.concise_description: Creates 3 darts, each requiring its own ranged spell attack roll, dealing 2d4 force damage on a hit; a natural 20 deals 5d4 instead of the normal crit damage, while any natural 1 causes all darts to instead hit you for 1 force damage each (+1 dart per slot above 1st, and +1 gp tax per slot above 1st).

Jump.name: Jump
Jump.concise_description: Touched creature's jump distance triples until the spell ends.

Light.name: Light
Light.concise_description: Touched object (max 10 ft) sheds bright light 20 feet and dim light 20 feet further, in a color of your choice, until dismissed, recast, or fully covered; if held/worn by a hostile creature, that creature can avoid the effect with a Dexterity save.

Lightning Lure.name: Lightning Lure
Lightning Lure.concise_description: Target within 15 feet makes a Strength save or is pulled up to 10 feet toward you, taking 1d8 lightning damage if it ends within 5 feet of you (+1d8 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Longstrider.name: Longstrider
Longstrider.concise_description: Touched creature's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends (+1 target per slot above 1st).

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.concise_description: Touched creature not wearing armor has its base AC become 13 + Dexterity modifier until the spell ends or armor is donned.

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.concise_description: Create a spectral hand that manipulates objects, opens/closes unlocked containers, or pours out a vial from up to 30 feet away, moving up to 30 feet per use; can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 lb; vanishes if it exceeds 30 feet from you or if you recast.

Magic Missile.name: Magic Missile
Magic Missile.concise_description: Creates 3 darts of force that automatically hit (no attack roll); each dart deals 1d4+1 force damage, split among targets as you choose (+1 dart per slot above 1st).

Magic Stone.name: Magic Stone
Magic Stone.concise_description: Imbue up to three pebbles; thrown or sling-hurled as a ranged spell attack (60 ft if thrown; if someone else attacks, they use your spellcasting modifier instead of theirs) dealing 1d6 + spellcasting modifier bludgeoning damage on a hit; the effect ends on the stone after use, or early on any stones if you recast.

Magnify Gravity.name: Magnify Gravity
Magnify Gravity.concise_description: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 force damage and having its speed halved until the end of its next turn on a fail, or half damage with no speed reduction on a success; until your next turn, moving an unattended object in the sphere requires a Strength check vs your spell save DC (+1d8 per slot above 1st).

Mending.name: Mending
Mending.concise_description: Repairs a single break or tear no larger than 1 foot in a touched object, leaving no trace; can physically (not magically) repair magic items or constructs.

Message.name: Message
Message.concise_description: Whisper a message to a target that only it hears and can whisper a reply to; can pass through solid barriers (blocked by magical silence, 1 ft stone, 1 in metal, thin lead, or 3 ft wood) if you know the target is beyond them.

Mind Sliver.name: Mind Sliver
Mind Sliver.concise_description: Target makes an Intelligence save or takes 1d6 psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw before the end of your next turn (+1d6 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Minor Illusion.name: Minor Illusion
Minor Illusion.concise_description: Create a sound (whisper to scream) or a static image (max 5-foot cube, no other sensory effects) that lasts the duration or until dismissed/recast; physical interaction, or an Intelligence (Investigation) check vs your spell save DC by an examining creature, reveals it as illusory.

Mold Earth.name: Mold Earth
Mold Earth.concise_description: Choose a 5-foot cube of earth/stone within range and: excavate/move loose earth up to 5 feet (no damage); etch shapes/words/patterns (1 hour); or make ground difficult or normal terrain (1 hour); up to two non-instantaneous effects can be active at once, each dismissible as an action.

Poison Spray.name: Poison Spray
Poison Spray.concise_description: Target makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 poison damage (+1d12 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.concise_description: Choose one: a harmless instantaneous sensory effect; light/snuff a small flame; clean or soil an object (max 1 cu ft); chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cu ft of material for 1 hour; mark an object/surface for 1 hour; or create a handheld trinket/illusory image lasting until the end of your next turn; up to three 1-hour effects can be active at once, each dismissible as an action.

Primal Savagery.name: Primal Savagery
Primal Savagery.concise_description: Melee spell attack dealing 1d10 acid damage on a hit (+1d10 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Produce Flame.name: Produce Flame
Produce Flame.concise_description: A flame in your hand sheds bright light 10 feet and dim light 10 feet further until dismissed, recast, or thrown; as an action (including the casting turn), hurl it as a ranged spell attack at a target within 30 feet for 1d8 fire damage, which ends the spell (+1d8 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Protection from Evil and Good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
Protection from Evil and Good.concise_description: Touched willing creature gains, against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead until the spell ends: those creatures have disadvantage attacking it, and it can't be charmed/frightened/possessed by them (advantage on a new save if already so affected).

Purify Food and Drink.name: Purify Food and Drink
Purify Food and Drink.concise_description: Purifies all nonmagical food and drink in a 5-foot-radius sphere, removing poison and disease.

Ray of Frost.name: Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.concise_description: Ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 cold damage; target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn (+1d8 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Ray of Sickness.name: Ray of Sickness
Ray of Sickness.concise_description: Ranged spell attack dealing 2d8 poison damage; target also makes a Constitution save or is poisoned until the end of your next turn (+1d8 per slot above 1st).

Resistance.name: Resistance
Resistance.concise_description: Touched willing creature can add a rolled d4 to one saving throw of its choice before the spell ends (once).

Sacred Flame.name: Sacred Flame
Sacred Flame.concise_description: Target makes a Dexterity save (gains no benefit from cover) or takes 1d8 radiant damage (+1d8 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
Sanctuary.concise_description: Any creature targeting the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom save, choosing a new target or losing the attack/spell on a fail; doesn't stop area effects; ends if the warded creature attacks, casts a harmful spell, or deals damage.

Sapping Sting.name: Sapping Sting
Sapping Sting.concise_description: Target makes a Constitution save or takes 1d4 necrotic damage and falls prone (+1d4 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Searing Smite.name: Searing Smite
Searing Smite.concise_description: Next melee hit before the spell ends deals an extra 1d6 fire damage and ignites the target; at the start of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save, taking 1d6 fire damage on a fail or ending the spell on a success (also ends if the flames are doused) (+1d6 initial damage per slot above 1st).

Shape Water.name: Shape Water
Shape Water.concise_description: Choose a 5-foot cube of water within range and: move/redirect it up to 5 feet (no damage); shape and animate it (1 hour); change its color/opacity (1 hour); or freeze it if no creatures are present (thaws in 1 hour); up to two non-instantaneous effects can be active at once, each dismissible as an action.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.concise_description: Reaction: gain +5 AC (including against the triggering attack) until the start of your next turn, and take no damage from magic missile.

Shield of Faith.name: Shield of Faith
Shield of Faith.concise_description: Target gains +2 AC for the duration.

Shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
Shillelagh.concise_description: For the duration, use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for a held club or quarterstaff's attack and damage rolls, its damage die becomes a d8, and it counts as magical; ends if recast or you release the weapon.

Shocking Grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
Shocking Grasp.concise_description: Melee spell attack (advantage if target wears metal armor) dealing 1d8 lightning damage; target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn (+1d8 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Silent Image.name: Silent Image
Silent Image.concise_description: Creates a purely visual image (max 15-foot cube) that you can move within range as an action, altering its appearance to seem natural; physical interaction, or an Intelligence (Investigation) check vs your spell save DC by an examining creature, reveals it as illusory (and lets that creature see through it).

Silvery Barbs.name: Silvery Barbs
Silvery Barbs.concise_description: Reaction: the triggering creature must reroll its d20 and use the lower result; you then grant a creature of your choice (including yourself) advantage on its next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw within 1 minute (only one such empowerment active at a time).

Sleep.name: Sleep
Sleep.concise_description: Roll 5d8 as a pool of hit points; creatures within 20 feet (lowest current HP first, ignoring unconscious) fall unconscious until the spell ends, take damage, or are shaken/slapped awake, as their HP is subtracted from the pool until it runs out; undead and creatures immune to being charmed are unaffected (+2d8 per slot above 1st).

Snare.name: Snare
Snare.concise_description: Creates a nearly invisible trap (Intelligence (Investigation) check vs your spell save DC to spot) in a 5-foot-radius circle; a Small/Medium/Large creature that enters makes a Dexterity save or is hoisted upside down 3 feet up and restrained. A restrained creature can save at the end of each of its turns, or anyone can use an action for an Intelligence (Arcana) check vs your spell save DC, to end the restraint; the spell ends once no one is restrained after triggering.

Spare the Dying.name: Spare the Dying
Spare the Dying.concise_description: Touched creature at 0 hit points becomes stable; no effect on undead/constructs.

Speak with Animals.name: Speak with Animals
Speak with Animals.concise_description: Comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration; they can share information (limited by their intelligence) about nearby locations/monsters perceived within the past day, and might be persuaded to help.

Sword Burst.name: Sword Burst
Sword Burst.concise_description: Each creature other than you within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 force damage (+1d6 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Tasha's Caustic Brew.name: Tasha's Caustic Brew
Tasha's Caustic Brew.concise_description: Each creature in a 30-by-5-foot line makes a Dexterity save or is covered in acid, taking 2d4 acid damage at the start of each of its turns until removed (action to scrape/wash off) or the duration ends (+2d4 per slot above 1st).

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
Tasha's Hideous Laughter.concise_description: Target (Intelligence 4 or lower is unaffected) makes a Wisdom save or falls prone, incapacitated and unable to stand, for the duration; it repeats the save at the end of each turn and whenever it takes damage (advantage if triggered by damage), ending the spell on a success.

Tenser's Floating Disk.name: Tenser's Floating Disk
Tenser's Floating Disk.concise_description: Creates a 3-foot, 500-lb-capacity force disk hovering 3 feet above the ground that follows within 20 feet of you (ends if it can't stay within 100 feet of you, must cross a 10+-foot elevation change, or is overloaded).

Thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
Thaumaturgy.concise_description: Choose one 1-minute or instantaneous effect: amplify your voice 3x; flicker/change flames; cause harmless ground tremors; create an instantaneous sound; slam open/shut an unlocked door/window; or alter your eyes' appearance; up to three 1-minute effects can be active at once, each dismissible as an action.

Thorn Whip.name: Thorn Whip
Thorn Whip.concise_description: Melee spell attack dealing 1d6 piercing damage; if the target is Large or smaller, pull it up to 10 feet closer to you (+1d6 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
Thunderclap.concise_description: Each creature other than you within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 thunder damage; audible 100 feet away (+1d6 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Thunderous Smite.name: Thunderous Smite
Thunderous Smite.concise_description: First melee hit during the spell's duration deals an extra 2d6 thunder damage (audible 300 feet); target also makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

Thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
Thunderwave.concise_description: Each creature in a 15-foot cube from you makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet on a fail, or half damage with no push on a success; unsecured objects in the area are also pushed 10 feet, and the effect is audible 300 feet away (+1d8 per slot above 1st).

Toll the Dead.name: Toll the Dead
Toll the Dead.concise_description: Target makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d8 necrotic damage (1d12 instead if it's missing any hit points) (extra die at 5th/11th/17th level).

True Strike.name: True Strike
True Strike.concise_description: On your next turn, gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided the spell hasn't ended.

Unseen Servant.name: Unseen Servant
Unseen Servant.concise_description: Creates an invisible Medium force (AC 10, 1 HP, Str 2, can't attack; ends at 0 HP) that performs simple tasks (fetching, cleaning, etc.) on command; as a bonus action, move it up to 15 feet and have it interact with an object; ends if commanded more than 60 feet from you.

Vicious Mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
Vicious Mockery.concise_description: Target, if it can hear you, makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn (+1d4 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Witch Bolt.name: Witch Bolt
Witch Bolt.concise_description: Ranged spell attack dealing 1d12 lightning damage; on each of your later turns you can use your action to automatically deal 1d12 lightning damage again, ending if you act otherwise or the target leaves range or gains total cover (+1d12 initial damage per slot above 1st).

Word of Radiance.name: Word of Radiance
Word of Radiance.concise_description: Each creature of your choice you can see within range makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage (+1d6 at 5th/11th/17th level).

Wrathful Smite.name: Wrathful Smite
Wrathful Smite.concise_description: Next melee hit during the spell's duration deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage; target also makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you until the spell ends (it can end the spell early with an action and a Wisdom check vs your spell save DC).

Zephyr Strike.name: Zephyr Strike
Zephyr Strike.concise_description: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the duration; once before it ends, gain advantage on one weapon attack (extra 1d8 force damage on a hit) and your walking speed increases by 30 feet until the end of that turn, whether you hit or miss.
